validity.recommendation: No action on existence/duplicate. This is a real, heavily-documented, currently-active offshore construction project (Saipem's Bouri Gas Utilisation Project / BGUP for Mellitah Oil & Gas, the Eni-NOC Libya JV). Note: P6716 and roster-mate P7617 share the identical pipeline_name 'DP3–DP4–Sabratha Gas Pipeline' but are correctly two different physical segments of one 28km subsea system, not a duplicate: P6716=segment_name 'DP3–DP4' (8.5km, 14in, raw gas) and P7617=segment_name 'DP4–Sabratha' (20km, 10in/4in, dehydrated gas+condensate). 8.5+20=28.5km matches the JPT/Saipem/rivieramm/lywitness figure of '28 km of pipelines connecting the DP3, DP4 and Sabratha platforms' almost exactly, and nsenergybusiness.com + oedigital.com both independently break the 28km total down into exactly these same two segments with the same lengths/diameters GEM already has. Consider renaming P6716's pipeline_name to something segment-specific (e.g. 'DP3–DP4 Gas Pipeline') so it stops looking like an accidental duplicate of P7617's row at a glance — cosmetic only, not a data error.
validity.researcher_notes: Existence: independently confirmed by jpt.spe.org (SPE, 2023-08-09, verified OK), saipem.com press release (2023-08-09, verified OK), nsenergybusiness.com project page (verified OK) and news article (verified OK), rivieramm.com (verified OK), oedigital.com (2026-05-06, verified OK), Zawya/Reuters via tradingview.com (2026-05-07, verified OK), plus Arabic press lywitness.com and attaqa.net (both verified OK/live) and the operator's own site mellitahog.ly (verified OK, confirms DP3/DP4/Sabratha platforms exist and are operated by Mellitah Oil & Gas). Multiple fully independent origins (SPE trade press, Saipem corporate, two separate offshore-industry trade outlets, Reuters wire, Arabic Libyan press, operator site) all agree on the same project, same platform names, same 28km total — no hallucination risk here. Duplicate check against roster: ruled out, see recommendation — P6716 and P7617 are complementary segments of the same 28km system, each independently corroborated with matching per-segment lengths/diameters, not a double-count of one pipe.

GEM's controlled vocab for PipelineType is transmission / gathering / distribution (docs/reference/controlled_vocab.md). nsenergybusiness.com (verified OK) states explicitly this 8.5km/14in DP3-DP4 line's purpose is to 'transport raw gas from DP3 to DP4' — i.e. it moves unprocessed wellstream gas between two adjacent offshore production platforms so it can be treated at DP4, not treated/sales-quality gas moving to market. That is a textbook inter-platform gathering line, not a transmission trunk. (By contrast the downstream P7617 segment DP4-Sabratha carries already-dehydrated gas + condensate toward the onshore complex, which is a more defensible transmission call — that segment is out of scope here but worth a look too.) The sheet's only cited ref for PipelineType (jpt.spe.org) never uses the word 'transmission' or 'gathering' at all — it just describes the project generally — so the current classification isn't actually supported by its own citation.

The sheet's existing StartYear1=2028 ref (zawya.com/.../saudis-gas-arabian-services-company-bags-2-epc-contracts-from-aramco...) verifies as HTTP 400 and, going by its own URL slug, is actually about a Saudi Aramco EPC contract — unrelated to this Libya pipeline — so it should never have supported this value.

summary: P6716 (DP3-DP4 segment of the Bouri Gas Utilisation Project, offshore Libya) is real and well-corroborated (not a hallucination, not a duplicate of roster-mate P7617's DP4-Sabratha segment); flagged for reclassification (transmission->gathering, this carries raw untreated gas between platforms), an attribution fix (EndLocation wrongly says 'Sabratha platform', should be 'DP4 Platform'; StartLocation blank, should be 'DP3 Platform'), and a spec/date fix (StartYear1 should move from 2028 to 2026-09 per two independent May-2026 sources; the sheet's only Start-date citation is dead and appears to be about an unrelated Aramco contract). Status='construction' is reconfirmed current as of 2026-05 (69% complete). Length (8.50km) and Diameter (14in) values confirmed correct by independent sources and given fresh refs; Length ref was previously missing entirely.
